description: The workspace's facts, as Brand Control, Products & ICPs, Facts lists them: the prices, plans and promises AI's answers are checked against each week, each with its type, the product a seeded fact follows, and the open action item when an answer contradicts it. Also returns the contradictions of the last 30 days: the fact, the engine, the question, the answer's sentence and its sources.
name: list_brand_facts
